title: Administrative Policy
description: How PDDF is run day to day: decision making, roles and office procedures.
description_ne: मञ्चको दैनिक सञ्चालन: निर्णय प्रक्रिया, भूमिका र कार्यालय कार्यविधि।

title: Financial Management Policy
description: How funds are received, approved, spent, recorded and audited.
description_ne: रकम प्राप्ति, स्वीकृति, खर्च, लेखाङ्कन र लेखापरीक्षणको तरिका।

title: Personnel Policy
description: Recruitment, staff rights and duties, leave and conduct of staff.
description_ne: कर्मचारी भर्ना, अधिकार र कर्तव्य, बिदा र आचरण।

title: Anti-Fraud and Anti-Corruption Policy
description: Zero tolerance for fraud and corruption, and how concerns are reported and handled.
description_ne: जालसाजी र भ्रष्टाचारप्रति शून्य सहनशीलता, र उजुरी गर्ने तथा कारबाहीको प्रक्रिया।

title: Code of Conduct
description: The standards of behaviour expected from board members, staff and volunteers.
description_ne: कार्यसमिति सदस्य, कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकबाट अपेक्षित आचरणका मापदण्ड।
